title: alangium nobile
intro: Alangium nobile, commonly known as the Himalayan Alangium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Alangiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents in Alangium nobile are believed to contribute to its potential health benefits, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
